reasons: The three images successfully establish a distinct editorial narrative: Image 1 provides a wide-scale overview of the crop rows and environment; Image 2 acts as agronomic evidence by showing the young beet vegetation and soil texture in close-up; and Image 3 completes the irrigation-system story with the introduction of installation tools and machinery. Despite a stylistic continuity in lighting and color grading, the camera angles and foreground focal points are sufficiently different to avoid duplication. The presence of the AFP product in all three serves as a unifying brand element rather than a violation of the rule against identical product identification.
